[[File:Michael Mikaelian 1996 Worlds.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Michael Mikaelian at the 1996 World Championship. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Michael Mikaelian''' of Brooklyn, New York, won the [[1996 GenCon Open]] and finished 29th at the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]. He wrote the special report [[Star Wars World Championships (InQuest)]] in ''[[InQuest]]'' #22. InQuest #20 printed his Killer Decks II Yavin 4 Counterstrike deck.<ref name="inquest">Michael Mikaelian, "Star Wars World Championships", ''InQuest'' #22 (February 1997), p. 14. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-magazine-issue-22 InQuest Magazine Issue 22], Internet Archive.</ref>

He posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1998.<ref name="list-55378">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/55378.html? swccg-discussion message #55378], [[Michael Mikaelian]] (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108181353/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/55378.html? Internet Archive]</ref>
